payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped FrickSessionManager (StateFlow<SessionState>: session/isAuthenticating/lastError/isAuthenticated; verbs signIn/signUp/signOut/requestPasswordReset/resetPassword) riding FrickClient encrypted SQLite persistence. Added FrickClient.currentSession getter + password-reset verbs + public replicaId. Demo ViewModel auth path now rides the manager. Gate: pnpm typecheck exit 0, :frick:testDebugUnitTest green. Note: :app module does not compile from baseline (missing generated ConversationDto/UserDto/RoomMemberDto) — pre-existing, unrelated to this change.
